extras: The plugin requires the server and CLI to be on the same release train (MAJOR.MINOR) for guaranteed compatibility.
intentEvidence: The plugin talks only to the server URL you configure. That is your server, or the one your operator runs. No third-party services, no analytics, no telemetry, no ads.
problem: Users require a private, end-to-end encrypted, and self-hosted solution for synchronizing their Obsidian vault without relying on third-party services.
summary: A plugin that sync's an Obsidian vault with a self-hosted ovaultd server using end-to-end encryption and revision-based tracking.
